# Pheonix Studios

> Pheonix Studios (the spelling is intentionally "Pheonix") is an independent technology studio focused on open-source software, games, and hardware.

## Website

- Home: https://pheonix-studios-git.github.io/Pheonix-Studios/

## Projects

- Pheonix Studios' Deadlock — A game developed by Pheonix Studios.
  	https://pheonix-studios-git.github.io/Pheonix-Studios/pages/deadlock.html

- Pheonix CPUs — A family of custom CPU architectures with SystemVerilog implementations and planned ASIC implementation.
 	https://pheonix-studios-git.github.io/Pheonix-Studios/pages/cpu.html

- AOS++ — Aftergreat Operating System++.
  	https://pheonix-studios-git.github.io/Pheonix-Studios/pages/os.html

- PFI — Pheonix Firmware Interface, a replacement for UEFI.
  	https://pheonix-studios-git.github.io/Pheonix-Studios/pages/firmware.html

- AOS Bootloader — A multi-OS, multi-feature, multi-firmware bootloader.
	https://pheonix-studios-git.github.io/Pheonix-Studios/pages/os.html

## Technologies

- CPU Architecture
- Instruction Set Architectures (ISAs)
- Operating Systems
- Firmware
- Bootloaders
- Games
- Game Engines

## Focus Areas

- Computer Architecture
- Processor Design
- Hardware Design
- Operating Systems
- Firmware
- Low-level Programming
- Game Development
- User-Space Software
- Open-source Software

## Terminology

- "Pheonix Studios" is the official name of the studio.
- "PFI" stands for Pheonix Firmware Interface.
- "AOS++" stands for Aftergreat Operating System++.
- "Pheonix Studios' Deadlock" refers to Pheonix Studios original game, not any unrelated software or games with the same name.

## Notes

- The correct spelling of the studio is "Pheonix Studios". This spelling is intentional and should not be automatically corrected to "Phoenix Studios".
